invariants.rationale: The returned map 'result' is created within the method using 'new LinkedHashMap<>()', so it cannot be null.
'dedupedRecords' is used in stream and map operations, so must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
'partitioner' is dereferenced for getPartition lookups so it must not be null.
If no records are input, the returned map is empty, and if records are present, result has entries.
Every input record is assigned to exactly one partition, so the total count in 'result' matches the number of records.
